yarin: Minimal examples below to copy into docs (please keep them short):
```python
# py example
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient(api_key=...)
async def run(resume=None):
    stream = await client.start_stream(model='redwood-rlm', resume_token=resume, max_inflight=4)
    async for c in stream:
        print(c.text)
        if should_pause():
            await stream.drain()
    return stream.resume_token
```
eli: TS draft: 
```ts
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
async function consume(resumeToken?: string){
  const stream = client.stream({ model: 'redwood-rlm', resumeToken, maxInflight: 5 })
  for await (const chunk of stream){
    console.log(chunk.text)
    if (needThrottle()) await stream.drain()
  }
  return stream.resumeToken
}
```
